title: bertya cupressoidea
intro: Bertya cupressoidea, commonly known as the Copper Burr, is a plant species native to Australia. It is a shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rutaceae family. Bertya cupressoidea is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as pain relief, wound healing, and protection against oxidative stress.
